VIDEO TITLE: Weeknight Chicken Kelaguen
SPOKEN CONTENT: Finely chop 2 cups cooked chicken. Mix it with one half cup lemon juice, one half cup grated coconut, one quarter cup chopped green onion, and one minced hot pepper. Season with half a teaspoon salt. Chill for 20 minutes and serve with warm titiyas.

Classic Banana Bread. Yield: one loaf. Ingredients: 3 ripe bananas, 1/3 cup melted butter, 3/4 cup brown sugar, 1 beaten egg, 1 teaspoon vanilla, 1 teaspoon baking soda, a pinch of salt, and 1 1/2 cups flour. Heat oven to 350 F. Mash bananas, stir in butter, sugar, egg, and vanilla. Fold in the dry ingredients. Bake in a loaf pan for 50 to 60 minutes.

GUAM RED RICE
2 cups jasmine rice
2 1/2 cups water
1 tbsp achote powder
1 tsp salt
1 tbsp oil
Rinse rice. Stir achote and salt into water. Combine everything in a pot. Bring to a boil, cover, and simmer 18 minutes. Rest 10 minutes before fluffing.

PUMPKIN TURNOVERS - PAGE 1
Filling:
2 cups pumpkin puree
1/2 cup brown sugar
1 tsp cinnamon
1/4 tsp nutmeg
Cook filling in a saucepan for 8 minutes, then cool.

PUMPKIN TURNOVERS - PAGE 2
Dough:
2 cups flour
1/2 tsp salt
2/3 cup cold butter
6 tbsp ice water
Cut butter into flour and salt. Add ice water. Roll and cut circles. Fill, fold, crimp, and bake at 375 F for 25 minutes.
